meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 处理数据文件时,Claude 会用 Python 工具链(经 uv 运行),自动在 DuckDB 与 Polars 间选更快的,始终带 numpy 与 pyarrow,绝不用 pandas。可读取 CSV/Parquet/JSON 等,做过滤、排序、聚合等。
howto.when: 当用户说“分析这个文件”,或要求做分组汇总、画图等数据处理时触发。不用于纯文本、配置文件或简单心算。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件,按分类汇总销售额
say.note: Claude 会用 DuckDB 或 Polars 做聚合

say.text: 过滤出金额大于 100 的行,按日期排序
say.note: Polars 过滤排序,返回结果

say.text: 合并这两个数据集,画个趋势图
say.note: 混合处理并生成 matplotlib 图表

howto.what_en: Claude processes data files via uv-run Python, picks DuckDB or Polars per operation, always bundles numpy & pyarrow, never pandas. Reads CSV/Parquet/JSON, performs filtering, sorting, aggregation.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like 'analyze this file', group/summary operations, or plotting. Not for plain text, configs, or trivial math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and sum sales by category.
say_en.note: Claude aggregates via DuckDB or Polars.

say_en.text: Filter rows with amount > 100 and sort by date.
say_en.note: Polars filters and sorts, returns result.

say_en.text: Merge these two datasets and plot a trend.
say_en.note: Hybrid processing with a matplotlib chart.
